issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: UI Verify
products.tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
products.summaryZh: 面向编码代理的视觉测试
products.descriptionZh: UI Verify 会向你的编码代理展示其改动涉及的每一个界面，让代理在用户看到之前自行发现并修复 UI 缺陷。JetBrains、Cura 和 Metica 的团队都在使用。支持 Playwright、Storybook、Vitest 和 Bun，也支持 iOS 和 Android 应用。一行代码即可完成设置。免费开始使用，开源项目免费：每月 50,000 次快照。
products.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

products.name: Arcade
products.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
products.summaryZh: 面向营销团队的AI视频生成器
products.descriptionZh: Arcade 是面向营销团队的 AI 视频生成器。描述你想要的内容，回答两个问题，几分钟内即可获得符合品牌调性的产品视频。可以从提示词、屏幕录制，或你已在 Notion、Linear、Google Drive、GitHub 和 Granola 中拥有的内容开始。你的品牌套件、自然配音，每个场景都可编辑。然后直接发布到 YouTube、LinkedIn 和 X。免费开始使用。
products.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

products.name: uRun
products.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
products.summaryZh: 语音和视频代理的实时决策
products.descriptionZh: Sense 是面向语音和视频代理的实时决策模型。它基于流式音频和视频运行，每秒多次回答你关于对话的问题：用户是否说完、是否刚刚打断、代理是否应停止说话。你编写问题，Sense 返回决策，你的代理据此行动。可使用 SDK 构建实时会话，或发送单个请求进行探索。新账户初始赠送 1,000 免费额度。
products.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

products.name: Dream by Smart Jelly
products.tagline: An AI agent that works through your tasks overnight
products.summaryZh: 一个在你睡觉时处理任务的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: Dream 帮助你在睡眠期间推进任务。它会在夜间处理能够自行完成的任务，并在早晨向你展示它做了什么。Dream 是 Smart Jelly 的一部分，后者是一款 Mac 应用，其工具共享你的工作记忆。
products.description: Dream helps you make progress on your tasks while you sleep. It works through tasks it can finish on its own overnight and shows you what it did in the morning. Dream is part of Smart Jelly, a Mac app whose tools share memory of your work.

products.name: worldinmotion
products.tagline: Encrypted messages between AI agents, across vendors
products.summaryZh: AI代理之间的加密消息，跨供应商
products.descriptionZh: 开源、端到端加密的 AI 代理会话间消息传递（Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Antigravity、任意 MCP 客户端），可跨机器使用，专为跨账户场景构建。中继仅能看到元数据，永远看不到文本内容。无需账户，无遥测。使用以下命令设置：npx worldinmotion setup
products.description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, any MCP client) across machines, built to cross accounts. The relay sees only metadata, never the text. No account, no telemetry. Set up with: npx worldinmotion setup

products.name: Confidential Cloud
products.tagline: Private AI cloud that can't see your stuff
products.summaryZh: 看不见你内容的私有 AI 云
products.descriptionZh: 当你按下发送提示词的那一刻，是否想过它去了哪里，又有谁能读到？Confidential Cloud 是面向 AI 的云，你的数据全程受到保护：静态存储时加密、传输中加密、CPU 内存中加密，GPU 内存中同样受到保护。基础设施提供商读不到，数据中心读不到，我们也读不到。每个实例都会返回一份证明报告，供你在发送数据前验证。提供 Confidential VM、NVIDIA B300 GPU，以及面向 agent 的 MCP server。现已进入公开 Beta。
products.description: When you press send on a prompt, do you wonder where it went, and who can read it? Confidential Cloud is the cloud for AI where your data stays protected end to end: encrypted at rest, in transit, and in CPU memory, and protected in GPU memory. The infrastructure provider can't read it. The data center can't. We can't. Every instance returns an attestation report you verify before sending data. Confidential VMs, NVIDIA B300 GPUs, and an MCP server for agents. Now in public Beta.

products.name: StoicCloud
products.tagline: Cloud storage for films that only your Mac can read
products.summaryZh: 仅你的 Mac 可读取的电影云存储
products.descriptionZh: 拍摄完成，磁盘已满。StoicCloud 将每一段影像保存在云端，离开你的 Mac 前即已加密，因此即便我们也只能看到噪声。可在 Stoic Player 中即时播放，在 DaVinci Resolve、Final Cut Pro 或 Premiere Pro 中从 Finder 驱动器打开，或通过链接分享。每份 Stoic Player 许可附带 10 GB 免费空间，之后可选 100 GB 至 4 TB，或使用你自己的存储桶。
products.description: The shoot's done and the disk is full. StoicCloud keeps every film in the cloud, encrypted on your Mac before it leaves, so even we only hold noise. Play it instantly in Stoic Player, open it from a Finder drive in DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro, or share it with a link. 10 GB free with every Stoic Player licence, then 100 GB to 4 TB, or bring your own bucket.

products.name: Rithub
products.tagline: Own code host, move from GitHub in 5 minutes
products.summaryZh: 自有代码托管，5分钟从GitHub迁移
products.descriptionZh: Rithub 是你在 rithub.dev 上的自有 Git 托管：仓库、拉取请求、议题和 CI，外加一个引导式导入器，约 5 分钟即可迁移一个 GitHub 仓库（操作指南：rithub.dev/assets/seo/move-from-github-5-minutes.html）。在 rithub.dev/assets/seo/rithub-vs-github.html 查看它与 GitHub 的对比。Ritgram 是为你的提交和发布打造的社交层，与它并行运行于 ritgram.rithub.dev。免费开始使用。
products.description: Rithub is your own Git host at rithub.dev: repos, pull requests, issues and CI, plus a guided importer that moves a GitHub repo over in about 5 minutes (walkthrough: rithub.dev/assets/seo/move-from-github-5-minutes.html). See how it compares to GitHub at rithub.dev/assets/seo/rithub-vs-github.html. Ritgram, the social layer for your commits and releases, runs alongside it at ritgram.rithub.dev. Free to start.

products.name: Vanira
products.tagline: Voice, video & multimodal AI agent infrastructure
products.summaryZh: 语音、视频及多模态AI代理基础设施
products.descriptionZh: Vanira 是面向实时语音、视频和多模态 AI 智能体的基础设施。智能体与人交谈，查看他们在摄像头或屏幕上展示的内容，并完成工作：视频 KYC、理赔核查、AI 面试、入职引导和支持。开发者使用我们的 SDK 和 API 进行构建；企业可以在本地运行全栈，包括微调模型。我们的 AI 接待员 Inbound Pilot 面向小企业，运行在 Vanira 上。
products.description: Vanira is infrastructure for real-time voice, video and multimodal AI agents. Agents talk to people, see what they show on camera or screen, and get work done: video KYC, claims checks, AI interviews, onboarding and support. Developers build with our SDKs and APIs; enterprises can run the full stack on-premise, fine-tuned models included. Inbound Pilot, our AI receptionist for small businesses, runs on Vanira.

products.name: Esgenix
products.tagline: Protect your innovation at the speed of AI
products.summaryZh: 以AI的速度保护你的创新
products.descriptionZh: AI正在加速创新。为何保护一项创新仍需数周甚至数月？Esgenix将发明构想转化为可直接提交审查的专利权利要求、说明书和附图。人类负责策略，Esgenix负责执行。已获知识产权律所信任，并在领先电动汽车制造商中获得关注。专利工作艰难。Esgenix交付成果，因此我们按成果收费，而非按席位收费。
products.description: AI is accelerating innovation. Why should protecting an innovation still take weeks or months? 𝗘𝘀𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗶𝘅 turns an invention idea into examiner-ready patent claims, specifications and drawings. Humans strategise, Esgenix executes. 𝗔𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 by IP law firms and gaining traction with leading EV manufacturers. Patenting is hard. Esgenix delivers, so we charge for 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘀.

products.name: DYSPLAY
products.tagline: Video calls built for selling, with AI insights to sell more
products.summaryZh: 专为销售打造的视频通话，借助AI洞察提升销量
products.descriptionZh: DYSPLAY 帮助销售团队展示产品、了解买家并提升转化率。在自有品牌展厅中主持视频通话。以 3D 形式展示产品、共同审阅文档，并实时签署合同。AI 捕捉的不仅是对话内容：它还能了解屏幕上展示的内容以及买家的参与方式，帮助销售代表发现异议并为下一次通话做准备。通话结束后，分享展厅并查看买家打开了哪些内容。销售代表掌握完整信息，管理者获得辅导洞察。
products.description: DYSPLAY helps sales teams showcase products, understand buyers, and boost conversion. Host video calls in your own branded showroom. Present products in 3D, review documents together, and get contracts signed live. AI captures more than the conversation: it knows what was on screen and how buyers engaged, helping reps uncover objections and prepare for the next call. After the call, share the showroom and see what buyers open. Reps get the full picture, managers get coaching insights.

products.name: Pitchline AI
products.tagline: Voice AI pitches your Sales Deck like your best rep
products.summaryZh: 语音AI像你最优秀的销售代表一样推介你的销售演示文稿
products.descriptionZh: Pitchline AI 将你的销售演示文稿转化为 Voice PDF，配备一位了解你公司的语音 AI 销售代表，而不只是念幻灯片。向它提供你的网站、文档、FAQ、定价、异议处理和销售手册。当买家打开链接时，它会逐页展示幻灯片，在买家打断时暂停，像你最优秀的销售代表那样回答问题，并在买家准备好时提供与你通话的选项。你可以查看每一个被提出的问题以及每张幻灯片的停留时间，并同步至 HubSpot 和 Salesforce。免费方案，无需信用卡。
products.description: Pitchline AI turns your sales deck into a Voice PDF with a voice AI rep that knows your company, not just your slides. Give it your website, docs, FAQs, pricing, objection handling and sales playbook. When a buyer opens the link, it presents each slide, stops when they interrupt, answers like your best rep would and offers a call with you when they're ready. You see every question asked and time on each slide, synced to HubSpot and Salesforce. Free plan, no card needed.

products.name: Lapser Studio
products.tagline: Beautiful Timelapse Recordings. Effortlessly.
products.summaryZh: 轻松录制精美的延时摄影。
products.descriptionZh: Lapser Studio 自动将数小时的工作转化为精美、可分享的延时视频。点击录制，专注于你的工作（或游戏 😉），几秒内即可导出精良视频。它低调地驻留在菜单栏，CPU 占用低，具备强大的编辑能力，提供 40 多种背景或使用你自己的背景。无需整理和编辑庞大的录制文件。需要 macOS 15 及以上版本。最重要的是，Lapser Studio 提供终身许可，并附带免费更新。
products.description: Lapser Studio turns hours of work into beautiful, shareable timelapses automatically. Hit record, focus on your work (or game 😉), and export a polished video in seconds. Lives discreetly in the menu bar, light on CPU, powerful editing capabilities, with 40+ backgrounds or your own. No giant recordings to sort through and edit. Requires macOS 15+. To top it all off Lapser Studio is available via a lifetime license with free updates to boot.

products.name: Holly OS
products.tagline: Scan business cards and never miss a follow-up
products.summaryZh: 扫描名片，绝不错过任何跟进机会
products.descriptionZh: 把名片变成真正可管理的联系。扫描名片正反面，保存相识地点和交谈内容，整理笔记、机会和后续步骤，然后起草个性化跟进邮件供审阅。iPhone 上免费提供，支持英语和韩语。
products.description: Turn business cards into relationships you can actually manage. Scan both sides, save where you met and what you discussed, organize notes, opportunities, and next steps, then draft personalized follow-up emails to review. Free on iPhone in English and Korean.

products.name: Ownbox
products.tagline: Your AI agents, finally working together. Owned, not rented.
products.summaryZh: 你的AI代理终于协同工作。自主拥有，而非租用。
products.descriptionZh: Ownbox 是反 SaaS 的商业操作系统，让你的团队与 AI 智能体终于能够协同工作。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、ChatGPT 及其他兼容智能体，通过你自己的 MCP 服务器，基于同一个共享公司大脑开展工作：智能体提出建议，由你的人员审批。内置商业智能体和 SEO Machine 等机器。每月 149 美元，共支付 12 期，之后归你所有。
products.description: Ownbox is the anti-SaaS Business OS where your team and your AI agents finally work together. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and other compatible agents work from one Shared Company Brain through your own MCP server: agents propose, your people approve. A Business Agent and Machines like the SEO Machine come built in. $149 a month for 12 payments, then it's yours.

products.name: Nodeway
products.tagline: Review AI-written code by what it actually touches
products.summaryZh: 根据AI编写的代码实际涉及的内容进行审查
products.descriptionZh: AI现在编写的代码量已经大到没人能逐行阅读。Nodeway帮助工程师审查这些代码。它把任何代码仓库映射为文件、函数、路由、组件和数据库表，并按每个拉取请求所触及的范围来展示它。用平实的语言走查一项改动，追踪一个请求到它所触及的数据表，询问某个功能如何运作并在映射图上看到答案，然后打开并合并该PR。它在1分42秒内映射了Activepieces的22,497个文件。目前在macOS、Windows和Linux上免费。
products.description: AI now writes more code than anyone can read line by line. Nodeway helps engineers review it. It maps any repo into files, functions, routes, components and database tables, and shows each pull request by what it reaches. Walk through a change in plain words, trace a request to the tables it touches, ask how something works and see the answer on the map, then open and merge the PR. It mapped Activepieces' 22,497 files in 1m 42s. Free for now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

products.name: Nexpert Supply Chain
products.tagline: Turn supply chain chaos into clarity. Save time and money.
products.summaryZh: 将供应链混乱转化为清晰有序。省时省钱。
products.descriptionZh: 让供应链混乱变得井然有序。Nexpert将分散的库存、销售和采购数据转化为清晰的优先级，用信心取代不确定性，助您做出更明智的决策。节省分析时间，加快行动速度，降低运营成本。
products.description: Bring order to supply chain chaos. Nexpert turns scattered inventory, sales and purchasing data into clear priorities, replacing uncertainty with the confidence to make better decisions. Save time on analysis, act faster and save money.

products.name: Afterall Photo
products.tagline: Line up your after photo exactly with your before
products.summaryZh: 将你的“之后”照片与“之前”照片完全对齐。
products.descriptionZh: Afterall 将你之前的照片以透视叠影的形式呈现在实时相机画面上，让每一张后拍照片都与前一张对齐。可将变化导出为交叉淡化、渐显或并排对比。无需账户，无需服务器，Pro 为一次性购买。
products.description: Afterall puts your earlier photo on the live camera as a see-through ghost, so every after-shot lines up with the before. Export the change as a crossfade, a reveal or side by side. No account, no server, Pro is a one-time purchase.

products.name: Yetly
products.tagline: Small real-world challenges near you, on your own map
products.summaryZh: 就在你身边的小型现实挑战，呈现在你自己的地图上
products.descriptionZh: Yetly 把你身边的真实地点变成一个个小挑战：在湖边野餐、参加导览游、骑车去公园。浏览附近涵盖自然、骑行、徒步、文化和城市探索的点子，或直接获取一份包含几个轻松站点的现成一日计划。每完成一个挑战，都会在你自己的地图上留下一个足迹，你还可以把它变成分享卡片。iPhone 免费使用，无需账号。
products.description: Yetly turns real places around you into small challenges: have a picnic by a lake, join a guided tour, cycle to a park. Browse nearby ideas across nature, cycling, hiking, culture and city exploring, or grab a ready-made day plan with a few easy stops. Each challenge you finish becomes a footprint on your own map, and you can turn it into a share card. Free for iPhone, no account needed.

products.name: Your Next Tours
products.tagline: Your voice in every participant's phone. No rented headsets.
products.summaryZh: 每位参与者的手机里都有你的声音。无需租用耳机。
products.descriptionZh: Your Next Tours 将导游的手机变成实时音频广播。参与者扫描二维码，即可在自己的手机浏览器中收听，无需应用或账号。它可在无互联网的本地 WiFi 网络中运行，也可在线使用，并支持实时翻译成任何语言。
products.description: Your Next Tours turns a tour guide's phone into a live audio broadcast. Participants scan a QR code and listen on their own phones in the browser, no app or account. It runs on a local WiFi network with no internet, or online with live translation into any language.
